_doc: 可达性回归集 —— 专门收集『世界允许但校验器容易误杀』的论断。目标不是让它们全部 pass,而是确保它们不被误判为 fabrication(捏造)。  ||  EXPANSION 2026-07-28: the valid side previously contained exactly ONE hard-to-verify citation, and its title was invented (rc-title-only-obscure). An invented title matches nothing at all; a real obscure paper matches something similar at a score below threshold. The near-miss regime — where a threshold error would actually bite — had zero coverage. The rc-hard-* entries below are REAL arXiv papers (their IDs are recorded in _provenance so the 'valid' label is auditable rather than asserted) cited title-only, which is how a citation loses its resolvable identifier in practice. 扩充说明:valid 侧此前只有一条难核验引用,且标题是编造的。编造的标题什么都匹配不上,而真实冷门论文会匹配到相似项、分数低于阈值 —— 阈值判断真正会出错的那个「近似命中区」覆盖为零。下面的 rc-hard-* 都是真实 arXiv 论文(ID 记在 _provenance 里,使 valid 标注可被第三方复核,而非作者断言),以仅标题形式引用 —— 这正是现实中引用丢失可解析标识的方式。  ||  SHELF LIFE: these are hard because the index has not caught up yet. As OpenAlex indexes them they will start to pass, and the set will quietly get easier without any test failing. Re-check periodically; a case that has become easy should be replaced, not kept for the score. 保质期:它们之所以难,是因为索引还没跟上。OpenAlex 收录后它们会开始 pass,而集合会在没有任何测试失败的情况下悄悄变简单。需定期复核 —— 变简单的样本应当替换,而不是留着刷分。
